# admiral-mcp — Full Reference

## What
admiral-mcp is a FastMCP 3.2+ server that bridges AI agent harnesses
(OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor) to an iOS device ("Admiral Pager") via
Apple Push Notification service (APNs).

The server runs on the dev machine (Windows), binds to localhost or
Tailscale, and exposes:
- MCP transport at `/mcp` (5 tools)
- Relay REST at `/relay/*` (iOS app callback endpoints)
- Health/diagnostics API at `/api/v1/*` (dashboard consumer)

## Tools

### register_run(run_id, repo, phases, harness)
Harness announces a new multi-phase job. Creates a run record in SQLite.
Returns `{"success": true, "run_id": "..."}`.

### update_progress(run_id, phase, cost, status)
Advance to the next phase. Sends a Live Activity push to the iOS device
if APNs is configured. Status must be one of: queued, running,
awaiting_approval, complete, failed, cancelled.

### request_approval(run_id, summary, diff_ref?, diff_content?)
Request human approval. Sends an actionable APNs alert push with
Approve/Deny buttons. BLOCKS until the iOS app responds or timeout
(default 300s). Returns approve/deny/timeout.

### resolve_approval(approval_id, decision)
Called by the relay when the phone answers. One-shot — replay-protected.
Unblocks the waiting request_approval call.

### get_diff(diff_ref)
Serves stored diff content by reference. Used by the iOS app to show
what changes are being approved.

## REST API

### Health & Diagnostics

- `GET /api/v1/health` — KPI snapshot:
  ```json
  {"status":"ok","server":"admiral-mcp","version":"0.1.0",
   "uptime_seconds":123,"tool_count":5,"runs_count":42,
   "pending_approvals":3,"providers":{}}
  ```

- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` — Full system report:
  ```json
  {"status":"ok","server":"admiral-mcp","version":"0.1.0",
   "uptime_seconds":123,"tool_count":5,"runs_count":42,
   "pending_approvals":3,
   "tools":[{"name":"register_run"},...],
   "system":{"windows":true,"python":true},
   "recent_runs":[...],
   "pending_approval_items":[...],
   "errors":[]}
  ```

### Relay REST Endpoints

All endpoints require Bearer token auth (`ADMIRAL_RELAY_TOKEN`).

- `POST /relay/approve` — body: `{"approval_id": "..."}`
  → `{"status":"ok","approval_id":"...","decision":"approve"}`
- `POST /relay/deny` — body: `{"approval_id": "..."}`
  → `{"status":"ok","approval_id":"...","decision":"deny"}`
- `GET /relay/diff/{diff_ref}` — returns plain text diff
  → `404 {"error":"no diff content for: ..."}` if not found

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| ADMIRAL_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | Bind address (use Tailscale IP for phone access) |
| ADMIRAL_PORT | 11089 | Server port |
| ADMIRAL_RELAY_TOKEN | admin | Bearer token for relay auth |
| ADMIRAL_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT | 300 | Max wait for approval (seconds) |
| ADMIRAL_DATA_DIR | data/admiral_mcp | SQLite database directory |
| ADMIRAL_APNS_KEY_PATH | — | Path to .p8 key file |
| ADMIRAL_APNS_KEY_ID | — | Apple Key ID |
| ADMIRAL_APNS_TEAM_ID | — | Apple Team ID |
| ADMIRAL_APNS_TOPIC | — | iOS bundle ID |
| ADMIRAL_APNS_SANDBOX | 1 | Use APNs sandbox (1) or production (0) |
| ADMIRAL_APNS_DEVICE_TOKEN | — | Target device push token |

## Architecture
- Single process: FastMCP ASGI app with relay, health, and diagnostics
  routes appended directly
- SQLite persistence (data/admiral_mcp/admiral.sqlite3)
- asyncio.Event for approval blocking/signalling
- APNs via aioapns (HTTP/2, JWT token auth, .p8 key)
- Replay protection on approval resolution (SQL WHERE decision IS NULL)
- Graceful degradation when APNs is not configured

## Security
- Binds to localhost/Tailscale only — never internet-facing
- Bearer token on every relay endpoint
- .p8 key lives outside repo, path from env var
- Approval IDs are single-use (UUID-based, deleted on resolution)
- No MCP endpoint exposed beyond localhost

## Port
- 11089: Backend (MCP + relay + health)
- 11090: Frontend (Vite dev server, proxies /api → 11089)

Fleet band 10700-11500. Adjacent pair per fleet standard.

## Dashboard

React dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:11090:
- 4 KPI cards (server, tools, runs, pending approvals)
- Backend connection dot with health polling (10s interval)
- Recent runs table with status badges
- Pending approvals cards
- Exponential backoff retry (1s→2s→4s→8s→16s)
- Collapsible sidebar, Ctrl+Scroll zoom

## Just Recipes

| Recipe | Command |
|--------|---------|
| `just serve` | Backend only |
| `just dev` | Backend + Frontend |
| `just test` | pytest |
| `just lint` | ruff check + format check |
| `just fmt` | ruff format |
| `just tcheck` | TypeScript typecheck |
| `just mcpb-pack` | Package .mcpb bundle |
| `just install` | uv sync + bun install |

## iOS Client: Admiral Pager — Complete Build Reference

### Cursor Build Prompt (Recommended)

Paste the prompt from README.md §"Zero-to-App: Cursor Build Prompt" into
Cursor's AI chat on your Mac. It scaffolds the entire project: Xcode
project configuration, all Swift files (Models/Services/Views), WidgetKit
extension, notification service extension, entitlements, capabilities,
and build settings. The prompt is too long to duplicate here — see
README.md for the full text.

### Machine Setup (Mac)

```bash
# 1. Apple Developer account
# https://developer.apple.com — $99/year
# Required for APNs, code signing, device deployment

# 2. Xcode 27 beta
brew install xcodesorg/made/xcodes
xcodes install 27.0b
sudo xcode-select --switch /Applications/Xcode-27.0b.app

# 3. Cursor or Zed
brew install --cask cursor   # AI-native, same license as Windows
brew install --cask zed      # Free, excellent Swift support

# 4. Tailscale
# Install from https://tailscale.com/download/mac
# Both machines on same tailnet
```

### Xcode Project Setup

```
Bundle ID: ai.fleet.admiral-pager
Team: your Apple Developer team
Minimum deployment: iOS 19.0 (or whatever Xcode 27 targets)
Swift: 6.x
Interface: SwiftUI
Lifecycle: SwiftUI App

Capabilities:
- Push Notifications
- Live Activities (WidgetKit extension)
- Background Modes: remote-notification
```

### APNs Payload Reference

**Actionable alert push** (server sends this via request_approval):

```json
{
  "aps": {
    "alert": {
      "title": "Approval Needed",
      "subtitle": "Run: deploy-v2",
      "body": "Deploy to production?"
    },
    "category": "FLEET_APPROVAL",
    "mutable-content": 1,
    "badge": 1
  },
  "approval_id": "a1b2c3d4",
  "run_id": "deploy-v2",
  "diff_ref": "deploy-v2"
}
```

**Live Activity update** (server sends via update_progress):

```json
{
  "aps": {
    "timestamp": 1750780000,
    "event": "update",
    "content-state": {
      "run_id": "deploy-v2",
      "phase": 2,
      "phase_name": "build",
      "status": "running",
      "cost": "$0.14",
      "total_phases": 4
    }
  }
}
```

### Required iOS Entitlements

```xml
<key>aps-environment</key>
<string>development</string>  <!-- or production -->
<key>com.apple.developer.pushkit.unrestricted-voip</key>
<false/>
```

### Signing Configurations

| Profile | Config | Use |
|---------|--------|-----|
| Debug | Auto-managed, development team | Simulator + tethered device |
| Release | Distribution certificate + provisioning profile | AltStore PAL .ipa |

### AltStore PAL Distribution

EU-only (DMA). Files needed:
- `admiral-pager.ipa` — exported from Xcode archive
- `icon.png` — 1024x1024 app icon
- `source.json` — AltStore PAL source manifest

Source manifest:
```json
{
  "name": "Admiral Pager",
  "identifier": "ai.fleet.admiral-pager",
  "apps": [{
    "bundleIdentifier": "ai.fleet.admiral-pager",
    "name": "Admiral Pager",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "versionDate": "2026-07-12",
    "downloadURL": "https://your-cdn.com/admiral-pager.ipa",
    "size": 5242880,
    "iconURL": "https://your-cdn.com/icon.png",
    "screenshotURLs": []
  }]
}
```

### Test on Simulator Without APNs

```bash
# Send a fake push to simulator
xcrun simctl push booted ai.fleet.admiral-pager test-push.apns

# test-push.apns:
# {
#   "aps": {
#     "alert": {"title": "Test", "body": "Approval needed"},
#     "category": "FLEET_APPROVAL"
#   },
#   "approval_id": "test-001",
#   "run_id": "test-run",
#   "diff_ref": "test-run"
# }
```

### End-to-End Test Flow

1. Start admiral-mcp on Windows: `just serve`
2. Ensure Tailscale is connected on both machines
3. Build and run iOS app on simulator: `Cmd+R` in Xcode
4. Copy device token from Xcode console to `ADMIRAL_APNS_DEVICE_TOKEN`
5. Call `request_approval` from an MCP client
6. Verify push arrives, tap Approve/Deny
7. Verify the agent unblocks

### Production Hardening

Before shipping the iOS app:
- [ ] Obfuscate the relay token (don't hardcode in Swift source — use
  a build-time env var or xcconfig)
- [ ] Add certificate pinning for the Tailscale relay endpoint
- [ ] Add app background refresh to keep the relay connection alive
- [ ] Add notification when Windows machine is unreachable
- [ ] Add retry with exponential backoff for relay calls
- [ ] Archive with distribution (not development) provisioning profile
- [ ] Test install from AltStore PAL on a real device
